responsibility: Explain US architecture professional-practice terms, phases, deliverables, roles, delivery methods, AIA contract families, CSI documentation systems, or NCS at a high level. Use for questions such as “what is a CD set?” or “what does 50% CDs mean?”; do not use for code/jurisdiction, outline-spec, agreement-scope, or work-plan work.
inputs: Question and selected source manifest metadata; original applicable publication required for substantive interpretation. No project required.

modes.when: Substantive interpretation requires original-source retrieval; directory-only listing uses metadata.
